profile_text.body:
Deere & Co. is a public company traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker DE, headquartered in Moline, Illinois, and registered with the SEC under CIK 0000315189. Its website, deere.com, presents the business as John Deere, covering agricultural, construction, and forestry machinery, along with technology and services. The site directs customers to find a John Deere dealer in their area or to purchase online.

The site's description of its offerings includes technology, but no specific AI products are tracked for the company, and no MCP servers are recorded. On the machinery side, the site names agriculture, construction, and forestry as its markets.

The company's litigation exposure is recorded in Illinois, with 374 cases. No individual cases are listed.
